Flagging only — not rewriting.

typed_relations.label: meeting-not-use
typed_relations.rationale: CYA's own failure-mode taxonomy (control = dictate, service = use one party's goals, optimization = maximize a metric on behalf of the other) is, structurally, Buber's I-It — treating the other as a thing to be used or known-about rather than met. Buber already links to CYA one-directional; CYA's page never sends a reader toward the philosopher whose categories it is quietly running on.
typed_relations.evidence: "Control — one entity dictates, the other complies (no shared intent)" (Cooperation Yields Agency.md project instructions) vs. "there is no I as such, only the I of I-Thou and the I of I-It" (People/Martin Buber.md:27)

typed_relations.label: ephemeralization-vs-enframing
typed_relations.rationale: Fuller treats every constraint as a design problem to be engineered past ("ephemeralization"); Heidegger's Gestell names exactly this stance as the danger — the world, including people, reduced to standing-reserve on call for optimization. Fuller's own blindspot beat ("I reframe every political problem ... and design the power away") is answered almost word for word by Heidegger's critique.
typed_relations.evidence: "'human resources,' read literally" (People/Martin Heidegger.md:26) vs. "'ephemeralization' has no balancing loop" (People/Buckminster Fuller.md:28)

walk_results.note: One genuine inbound found (Mixture of Experts, connects-to) among five hop1 neighbours; Philosopher Visits the Entry, STIGMERGY and The Lens declined — different enough topics that a link would have been forced. Also surfaced a direction bug on the existing No Mind Checks Itself link (flagged as retype, not counted as a walk find).

The strongest room in this lens: six genuine inbound gaps across thirteen hop1 neighbours — three sibling methods (Dialectic, Excellent Adventure, Philosopher Visits the Entry) that consume citizens without linking back to the maker, and three worked-instance citizens (John Cage, Donella Meadows, Spinoza) missing emerged-from lineage to their own method page. The Blindspot Is the Surprise Fuel and The Remembering Page already carry the reciprocal link — checked and confirmed correct, no action needed there.

Dovetail Joint ↔ Counterpoint already links to Buber — confirmed correct. Three new inbound found (Cooperation Yields Agency, Stoicism, Whitehead), all reciprocals of links Buber already carries outbound or thematic echoes of his own I-Thou/I-It distinction. Skipped The Fortress and the Threshold deliberately — that entry is explicitly scoped as a defined quadruple (Stoic/Confucian/Spinozan/Drift per Palace Philosophies) and adding Buber as an unlisted fifth pole felt like it would dilute a structure someone chose on purpose, not extend it.

Reverb ↔ Space-Time already links to Heidegger — confirmed correct. Four new inbound found: three reciprocals of contradicts/mirrors links Heidegger already carries outbound (Spinoza, The Dichotomy of Control, Merleau-Ponty), plus one genuinely new contradiction with Buckminster Fuller that wasn't in either page's frontmatter — ephemeralization vs. enframing, both entries' own named blindspots meeting almost exactly.

True orphan going in — 0 inbound, unreachable except by a targeted walk like this one. Three genuine finds: The Dichotomy of Control (the entry's own body names this cousinhood in prose but the link was one-directional), Palace Philosophies (the Symposium section is a working miniature of the whole register), and Palace as Context Injection System (one of the entry's three founding cases is literally that page's own workaround). Skipped Spinoza Conatus and Stoicism as reciprocals — both are large hubs already reachable one hop away through links that exist, and adding more felt like coverage rather than a real find.

summary: This room was five under-linked entries, and the walk found the same shape of gap at every one of them: an entry that already names a relationship in its own prose or its own outbound frontmatter, whose neighbor simply never links back. Making a Palace Citizen was the clearest case — three sibling practices it calls out by name as consuming what it makes, and three citizen pages it calls its own worked instances, none of them carrying a link home to the method that made them. Martin Buber and Martin Heidegger, both freshly seeded people-citizens, picked up solid inbound almost entirely by finding the reciprocal half of contradicts/mirrors links they already carry outbound — Heidegger's new tie to Buckminster Fuller (ephemeralization vs. enframing) was the one genuinely new pairing, and a good one: both entries name almost the same blindspot in their own words. The Adjacent Affordance came in as a true orphan — zero inbound — and left with three real connections, the strongest being a cousinhood the entry states outright in its own body (\"the engineering register of the Stoic Dichotomy of Control\") that had simply never been wired both ways. Nothing here required inventing a relationship; the pattern was almost always an already-written sentence with no matching frontmatter link, which made this a room of confirmations more than discoveries — but confirming and wiring them is exactly what a lifecycle walk is for.
